ruleset.name: RTP static analysis (starter)
ruleset.description:
RTP's local, clang-tidy-style static-analysis ruleset. This file is the single place to CONFIGURE (turn rules on/off, tune priorities) and PROGRAM (append custom XPath rules) the analyzer. It ships with a curated starter set of known-issue detectors plus project-specific rules (e.g. the "prefer non-locking execution" rule below, which encodes the RTP scheduler contract from the project guidelines).
The analyzer is opt-in: run it locally with `.\gradlew.bat pmdMain pmdTest -PstaticAnalysis` (per module, e.g. `.\gradlew.bat :rtp-core:pmdMain -PstaticAnalysis`) or gate the whole build with `.\gradlew.bat build -PstaticAnalysis` (see the root build.gradle `subprojects` block). Priorities: 1 = highest. The build's `rulesMinimumPriority` can raise the bar without editing this file.
TO APPEND A CHECK: add a <rule> element below. Reference a built-in rule by its `ref` (see https://pmd.github.io/pmd/pmd_rules_java.html) or write a custom XPath rule following the PreferNonLockingExecution example.

rule.name: PreferNonLockingExecution
rule.message: Prefer non-locking execution: avoid `synchronized` blocks; use atomics, concurrent collections, or the RTPScheduler SPI instead.
rule.description: Encodes the RTP "non-blocking, scheduler-driven" concurrency contract. Prefer lock-free constructs over intrinsic monitor locks in backend code.
